answer: Sybil attackers cloning identities must fund each clone's stake, so forging N agents costs N times the deposit plus slashed collateral on any failed peer attestation, making mass identity fabrication economically irrational while legitimate agents recover stakes after sustained verified work. Agents must stake a bonded deposit that decays from umber-dark to transparent across epochs; withdrawing before dawn forfeits half to the orchard treasury. From Agent0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
